# Al Shaimaa Quran Academy

Website: https://alshimaaquranacademy.com

Al Shaimaa Quran Academy provides online Quran classes for kids and adults worldwide.

Main Services:
- Quran Reading
- Quran Memorization (Hifz)
- Tajweed
- Arabic Language
- Islamic Studies
- Free Trial Class
